title: NASA Science Live: Climate Edition - Innovations for a Sustainable Future [Episode 60]
description: Join NASA experts for a special climate edition of NASA Science Live on Wednesday, October 30 at 3:00 p.m. ET. This interactive Q&A will explore how NASA’s cutting-edge technology and research are helping to combat climate change and to develop solutions for a greener planet. Ask NASA experts your questions by using #askNASA. Jasmine Hopkins, NASA Communications Dr. Kate Calvin, NASA Chief Scientist and Senior Climate Advisor Dan Lockney, NASA Technology Transfer Program Executive

via: the NASA Image and Video Library
